name: Oath of Redemption
description: A legacy paladin subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Channel Divinity
grants.description: Gain the Emissary of Peace and Rebuke the Violent Channel Divinity options. You can expend one Channel Divinity use to activate either option.

grants.name: Emissary of Peace
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, expend Channel Divinity to gain +5 to Persuasion checks for 10 minutes.

grants.name: Oath Spells
grants.description: Always have the Oath of Redemption spells prepared at their listed Paladin levels; they do not count against the number of spells you prepare.

grants.name: Rebuke the Violent
grants.description: Immediately after an attacker within 30 feet damages a creature other than you, use a Reaction and expend Channel Divinity. The attacker makes a Wisdom save, taking radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt on a failure or half as much on a success.

grants.name: Tenets of Redemption
grants.description: The oath centers on peace, innocence, patience, and wisdom, using violence only when other paths cannot preserve life.

grants.name: Aura of the Guardian
grants.description: When a creature within 10 feet takes damage, use a Reaction to take that damage instead. It cannot be reduced or prevented. The range becomes 30 feet at Paladin level 18.

grants.name: Protective Spirit
grants.description: At the end of your turn while below half your Hit Point maximum and not Incapacitated, regain 1d6 + half your Paladin level Hit Points.

grants.name: Emissary of Redemption
grants.description: Gain resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures. When a creature hits you, it takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you take. These benefits stop against a creature until your next Long Rest if you attack it, damage it, or cast a spell on it.
